purpose: Context control for selecting or clearing a Tree level in checkbox multi-selection mode.
useWhen: Adding select-all and select-none controls to a Tree selectionControls snippet.
Selecting a registered tree level without placing non-treeitem controls inside role="tree".

avoidWhen.reason: Rendering outside a Tree component — it requires Tree selectionControls context.
Selecting arbitrary data that is not represented by registered tree items or selectionScopeIds.
